issues.legal_issue: A gift made after the operative date does not qualify as a transfer for adequate consideration protected from land-ceiling restrictions.
material_facts: The matter arose from an appeal concerning land-ceiling proceedings and whether a transfer was protected from those proceedings.
The landholder transferred land by gift to his wife's brother after the operative date.
The land would have been subject to the ceiling provisions in the transferor's hands even if it had not been transferred.
The transfer was a gift, which is a transaction without consideration.
issues.conclusion: The gift did not satisfy the requirement of adequate consideration and was not protected by the exception; the appeals were dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 5(6) of the Uttar Pradesh Imposition of Ceiling on Land Holdings Act, 1960, makes a post-operative-date transfer inoperative where the land would otherwise have been subject to the Act. The proviso's clause (b) protects only transfers made in good faith and for adequate consideration. Since the Act does not define adequate consideration, its common-parlance meaning applies: it requires consideration beyond mere love and affection. A gift is made without consideration under section 122 of the Transfer of Property Act, 1882. The court relied on Tulsidas Kilachand v. Commissioner of Income-tax, Bombay City and Commissioner of Wealth-tax, Andhra Pradesh v. Khan Saheb Dost Mohd. Alladin.

rule.if: ceiling_transfer_appeal and post_cutoff_transfer and land_would_be_ceiling_subject and gift_without_consideration

predicates.ceiling_transfer_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal concerning whether a land transfer is protected from land-ceiling proceedings.
predicates.post_cutoff_transfer: The landholder transferred the land after the operative date for assessing the landholding.
predicates.land_would_be_ceiling_subject: The land would have been subject to the ceiling restriction in the transferor's hands if it had not been transferred.
predicates.gift_without_consideration: The landholder voluntarily transferred the land as a gift without receiving consideration.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns protection from land-ceiling proceedings and land that would otherwise be subject to the ceiling restriction was transferred after the operative date as a gift without consideration, the gift is not exempt from that restriction.
